experimental_method: Fixed-volume titanium-alloy reactor connected to a syringe pump, fH2 fixed by the hematite-magnetite buffer in KCl-H2O fluids at 400-500 C and 215-510 bar; vapour and single-phase fluid aliquots sampled and H2 measured by gas chromatography, K by ICP-OES, Cl by ion chromatography.
uncertainties_stated: Temperature +/-5 C; ICP-OES 3 % and IC 2 % (2 sigma); H2 standard reproducibility within 10 %; H2(aq) uncertainty +/-40 umol/kg stated for the error bars of Fig. 5 (text prints mmol/kg).
quality_remarks: Authors note Y_H2-Cl < Y_H2 at 500 C in the comparison with pure-water data is likely inter-dataset inconsistency, not salting-in. The Y_H2-Cl column depends on SUPCRT92 fugacities (derived). kg basis of the concentrations not stated.
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer was clean and every cell of all 18 rows matched the 200 dpi page image.
